design: Tier 2 (permission posture). Rollback: revert. D1. acceptEdits joins APPROVER_PERMISSION_MODES (the approver flag) and the run env's operator posture (who answers), decided together as for manual. D2. Claude only: Codex's acceptEdits is answered over its app-server protocol and Copilot has its own modes.

checked: agent_trigger.py:1648 operator posture only for manual

problem: `runner_commands.APPROVER_PERMISSION_MODES` holds only workspace and manual, so an acceptEdits run gets no --permission-prompt-tool: Claude refuses an outside Write itself, no permission_requests row exists, and the agent tells the operator to approve it in a dialog that does not exist (2026-10-15 sweep G7; re-driven on HEAD: no card).

requirements.statement: An acceptEdits Claude run MUST name the Hub's approval tool and have the operator answer, so every call Claude Code does not auto-approve under acceptEdits becomes an operator card.
Edits Claude Code auto-approves under acceptEdits MUST still run without a card.

summary: Under the Edit files posture (acceptEdits), a Claude call that Claude Code itself would ask permission for is put to the operator as a card, as under Ask me, instead of being refused with no card (F628; decision fix-D12).
